h1: Custom Blue Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom blue badges in bulk for your team or event. Perfect for identification, security, and branding. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Blue badges offer a professional, trusted look for employee identification, visitor passes, or event credentials. The color blue conveys reliability and authority, making it a popular choice for corporate security badges or conference name tags. Customize with your logo, text, and barcodes using screen printing or digital transfer. Choose from hard plastic, metal, or vinyl materials in various sizes. Blue badges help your team stand out while maintaining a polished appearance.
heroAltText: Custom blue badges with employee names and company logo printed on durable plastic
